items.title: 66096_Monk Montgomery oral history interview
items.q: So Wes was influenced under Charlie Christian but he went off, he was an extension from that.

ctx.x: That's not a bad way to start.

That's what I'm saying. So Wes was influenced under Charlie Christian but he went off, he was an extension from that. Anyhow, I remember when I finished that and came down, I was really embarrassed because of Wes and Errol. Boy, the giants that those guys were! But when I came off the stage and we were sitting there talking, I really felt OK. I felt OK when we were just staying there talking. It was
different when they were standing there watching and looking at me playing. Because I knew I didn't have it down, and I knew I wasn't getting it because my fingers were just killing me.
